pkgmetadata.longdescription: ceph-iscsi provides the common logic and CLI tools for creating and managing LIO iSCSI gateways backed by Ceph RBD. It installs the rbd-target-api daemon (restores LIO state on gateway restart and exposes a REST config API), the rbd-target-gw daemon (gateway stats REST API), and the gwcli management shell, which replaces targetcli for this use case. sys-cluster/ceph does not provide any of this itself; the RBD-to-LIO bridging is done by sys-block/tcmu-runner's rbd handler, which this package configures and manages.
